Resource.Name: Admin.Settings.FrontendAsset.Description
Resource.Value: Serve the storefront bundles from a CDN instead of from inside the application image, so a frontend release does not need a rebuild. Leave the base URL empty to keep serving them locally. Integrity hashes are stored here, separately from the files, so a compromised CDN cannot make a browser execute an altered bundle. These settings apply to every store - they are read once at startup, before any store is known.

Resource.Name: Admin.Settings.FrontendAsset.BaseUrl.Hint
Resource.Value: Absolute URL ending in a slash, including a version segment, for example https://example.blob.core.windows.net/bundles/v1/. Empty serves the bundles shipped inside the image.

Resource.Name: Admin.Settings.FrontendAsset.BaseUrl.Invalid
Resource.Value: Enter an absolute http or https URL ending in a slash.

Resource.Name: Admin.Settings.FrontendAsset.Manifest.Hint
Resource.Value: Contents of wwwroot/bundles/asset-manifest.json from the frontend build. It maps each bundle to its file name and integrity hash.

Resource.Name: Admin.Settings.FrontendAsset.Manifest.Invalid
Resource.Value: The manifest must be JSON containing an "assets" object. Paste the contents of asset-manifest.json.

Resource.Name: Admin.Settings.FrontendAsset.UseSubresourceIntegrity.Hint
Resource.Value: Emit integrity and crossorigin attributes so the browser verifies each bundle before running it. Turn off only to diagnose a mismatch - a blocked script is silent in the page and visible only in the browser console.

Resource.Name: Admin.Settings.FrontendAsset.RestartRequired
Resource.Value: Saved. The manifest is parsed once at startup, so restart the application for this to take effect.

Resource.Name: Admin.Settings.FrontendAsset.Resolved.NoIntegrity
Resource.Value: no hash - the browser will not verify this file
